# Fixture provenance

Small, uncompressed ASDF files for testing the gWCS evaluator (`src-tauri/src/core/astrometry/gwcs/`). The trimmed gwcs truth files under `truth/` hold 122 reference points per whole-WCS source (`world`, `world_no_bbox`, per-frame values, `invert`, `invert_no_bbox`, `exact_inverse_newton`), generated by gwcs 1.0.3. Each file holds one transform under the
top-level key `transform`, or one complete gWCS under the key `wcs`. `expected.json` maps every file name to
the inputs, the outputs, and the inverse values where an inverse exists. The `_meta` entry in that file
records the conventions and package versions.

## How they were made

Each fixture was produced by loading the real source with asdf, taking the model (or sub-model) named below,
and writing it again with `asdf.AsdfFile({key: obj}).write_to(path, all_array_storage="internal", all_array_compression=None)`.
The `*_inline.asdf` file uses `all_array_storage="inline"`, and every `*_std150.asdf` file uses `version="1.5.0"`.
Each file was then read back and evaluated again to produce `expected.json`. The values from the
re-read file are bit-identical to the values from the in-memory model for every file (`reread_matches_original_bitwise: true`).

There are no compressed blocks. The real Roman source used lz4 compression, but its arrays were written back
uncompressed here. Every file is under 20 KB except `wcs_jwst_nircam_crf_tweakreg.asdf` (22.7 KB).

The fixtures for the arithmetic operators and `constant` were added later with the same call and the same package
versions. `divide_cartesian_to_tan`, `tp_correction_jwst` and `wcs_jwst_nircam_crf_tweakreg` come from the
tweakreg-corrected `jw01475001001_02101_00002_nrca1_o001_crf.fits`. The four `arithmetic_*` files are synthetic:
they are built from astropy model classes (`Shift`, `Scale`, `Polynomial1D`, `Polynomial2D`, `Const1D`, `Const2D`)
with invented parameters and hold no third-party data. The `wcs_jwst_nircam_crf_tweakreg` entry of `expected.json`
also gives, per case, `exact_inverse_newton` (a Newton solution of the forward transform started from `invert_no_bbox`,
the method of the truth files) and its world residual in mas.

Generated with Python 3.15.0, gwcs 1.0.3, asdf 5.4.0, asdf-astropy 0.11.0, asdf-standard 1.5.0,
asdf-transform-schemas 0.6.0, asdf-wcs-schemas 0.5.0, asdf-coordinates-schemas 0.5.1, astropy 8.0.1, numpy 2.5.3,
scipy 1.18.1, stdatamodels 6.0.0, roman_datamodels 1.1.0.

Independent check: every file was also parsed without asdf, using a raw YAML reader and a
hand-written block reader with MD5 verification, and then evaluated with a numpy reference evaluator written from
the astropy and gwcs sources. The largest difference from `expected.json` was 4.6e-10 (pixel units, in a
WCS inverse); the forward outputs agree to 6e-12 or better. The Rust tests in `src-tauri/src/core/astrometry/gwcs/`
repeat the comparison against `expected.json` and `truth/`.

The `truth/*.json` files are trimmed copies of the gwcs 1.0.3 truth of the same generation run: `jw02739001001_02105_00001_nrca1`,
`jw02739002001_02101_00001_mirimage`, `jw01476003004_02201_00001_guider2` and `jw01475001001_02201_00001_nis` come from the
JWST `_cal.fits` files named by their ids; `gwcs_nircamwcs` and `gwcs_miriwcs` from the gwcs test data `nircamwcs.asdf` and
`miriwcs.asdf`; `gwcs_examples_image_wcs` from `docs/gwcs/wcs_examples.asdf`. The gwcs truth of the ten tweakreg-corrected
`jw01475001001_02101_00002_*_o001_crf.fits` (`crf_*.json`, same layout) is not committed; the `#[ignore]` test
`gwcs_real_crf_tweakreg_chains_match_truth` reads it from `ASTROBURST_GWCS_TRUTH_DIR`.

The real-data tests that read the complete JWST and Roman products (`#[ignore]`, names starting with `gwcs_real`) take their
input folders only from environment variables (`ASTROBURST_GWCS_DATA_DIR`, `ASTROBURST_GWCS_TRUTH_DIR`, `ASTROBURST_MAST_DIR`,
`ASTROBURST_DOCUMENTS_FITS_DIR`) and skip when a variable is unset or a file is absent; nothing in the repository points at a
particular machine.

## Tag versions

Writing the files fresh with ASDF standard 1.6.0 produces newer tag versions than some of the real sources
use. The `_std150` variants carry the older tags:

| model | real source tag | fixture (1.6.0) | `_std150` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rotation2D | rotate2d-1.3.0 (LRS) / 1.4.0 (slit_wcs) | rotate2d-1.5.0 | rotate2d-1.3.0 |
| Const1D | constant-1.4.0 (LRS) / 1.5.0 (slit_wcs) | constant-1.6.0 | constant-1.4.0 |
| Tabular1D | tabular-1.2.0 (LRS) / 1.3.0 | tabular-1.4.0 | tabular-1.2.0 |
| Pix2Sky_Gnomonic | gnomonic-1.3.0 | gnomonic-1.4.0 | gnomonic-1.2.0 |
| RotateNative2Celestial | rotate3d-1.4.0 | rotate3d-1.5.0 | rotate3d-1.3.0 |
| AffineTransformation2D | affine-1.4.0 | affine-1.5.0 | affine-1.3.0 |
| whole NIRCam gwcs fixture | compose-1.2.0 ... wcs-1.2.0 | compose-1.4.0 ... wcs-1.4.0 | compose-1.2.0 ... wcs-1.2.0 |

The rest of the files use the same tags as the JWST cal 2.0.1 and 3.0.0 files and the Roman files:
compose/concatenate/shift/scale-1.4.0, polynomial-1.3.0, remap_axes-1.5.0, identity-1.4.0,
rotate_sequence_3d-1.2.0, gwcs spherical_cartesian-1.3.0, wcs-1.4.0, step-1.3.0, frame2d/celestial_frame-1.2.0,
core/ndarray-1.1.0 and bounding_box-1.2.0. The arithmetic fixtures and the crf chain use add/subtract/multiply/divide/power-1.4.0,
affine-1.5.0 and constant-1.6.0, the tags the crf files themselves carry; from constant-1.4.0 on, `dimensions` selects Const1D or Const2D.

Edge cases covered by the expected values:
- `tabular1d_with_inverse`: inputs outside the table give NaN. The inverse of the first table value also gives NaN, because 14.39097 lies just outside the range of the inverse table's points (3.596 to 14.38788).
- `pix2sky_gnomonic` at (0, 0) gives phi = 0, as wcslib does. A naive `atan2(0, -0.0)` gives 180.
- `rotate_native2celestial` at the native pole (0, 90): the expected file keeps the forward value and leaves out the inverse, because the inverse longitude there is floating-point noise.
- `identity_inverse_mapping`: the inverse produces 4 outputs from 2 inputs.
- `poly2d_concat4_with_inverse`: the inverse is fed (o0, o1, o0, o1), the way the JWST chain feeds it.
- WCS fixtures: `output` is NaN outside the bounding box. `invert` follows gwcs's per-axis NaN rule; `invert_no_bbox` does not apply the box.
- Arithmetic operators apply output by output to the outputs of both operands, which take the same inputs; none of them has an analytic inverse. `arithmetic_operators_1d` at x = -4 gives NaN, because (-4 + 3) ** 0.5 is NaN for numpy arrays.
- `constant`: Const1D and Const2D return their value whatever the input, NaN included.

This covers `wcs_nircam_gwcs_fixture*.asdf`, `wcs_miri_gwcs_fixture.asdf`, `rotation_sequence_spherical_miri`, `mapping_drop_n_inputs`, `rotation2d*`, `const1d*`, `tabular1d*`, `pix2sky_gnomonic*`, `rotate_native2celestial*`, `affine2d*` and `wcs_gwcs_examples_tan`, and the truth files `truth/gwcs_nircamwcs.json`, `truth/gwcs_miriwcs.json` and `truth/gwcs_examples_image_wcs.json`, which are numbers computed from those files. That copyright notice and licence text is committed next to the fixtures as `LICENSE-gwcs.rst`.
- **JWST data from MAST** (programs 1475, 1476 and 2739: `jw01475...nis`, `jw01475..._00002_nrca1_o001_crf`, `jw01476...guider2`, `jw02739...nrca1`, `jw02739...mirimage`): publicly available JWST science data downloaded from MAST, past any exclusive-access period. This covers `shift`, `scale`, `concat_shift_shift`, `dva_correction`, `poly2d_*`, `poly1d_with_inverse`, `mapping_0101_inverse_identity`, `identity_inverse_mapping`, `mapping_swap`, `v23tosky_jwst`, `spherical_to_cartesian_wrap180`, `cartesian_to_spherical_wrap360`, `rotation_sequence_3d_cartesian`, `divide_cartesian_to_tan`, `tp_correction_jwst`, `wcs_jwst_*` and the truth files `truth/jw*.json`. The committed files hold only the WCS metadata (transform coefficients and frames) and numbers computed from it, never image data. MAST asks users to acknowledge the data (see below).
- **Synthetic arithmetic fixtures** (`arithmetic_*.asdf`): written for this project from astropy model classes with invented parameters; they contain no data from any third party.
- **Roman simulated product** (`r9999901001001001001_0001_wfi01_f129_wcs.asdf`, RomanCAL 1.0.1): the licence and redistribution terms are not established, so `wcs_roman_wfi01_l1.asdf` and the Roman truth files are **not committed**. The Roman chain is covered by `#[ignore]` real-file tests that read a local copy named through `ASTROBURST_GWCS_DATA_DIR` and by a synthetic test with the same structure.

The BSD-3 notice for the gwcs-derived fixtures is `LICENSE-gwcs.rst` in this directory, a verbatim copy of the upstream gwcs repository's `licenses/LICENSE.rst`; the same text is at `src-tauri/licenses/gwcs-LICENSE.rst`, which also covers the code ported from gwcs (`to_fits_sip` / `_utils` in `core/astrometry/gwcs/sip_fit.rs`).
